fact: Augentic signed a 15-year Build-Operate-Transfer contract with the DGSN on 13 May 2024 to produce and operate the new biometric national ID card system, with equipment and infrastructure to be handed over to the Cameroonian government once the 'Operate' component ends, according to Biometric Update.
system: new generation biometric national ID card

fact: The chief of the national identity-titles production centre, a police divisional commissioner, says the new biometric national ID card is now delivered within 48 hours as the decree provides, with applicants collecting it at police stations.

Journal du Cameroun reports that under a 15-year build-operate-transfer contract signed 13 May 2024, Augentic GmbH will finance, design, develop, install and operate Cameroon's identification system, with about 70 million euros of investment.
